_comment: Live settings. See README Findings before setting mode to 'live' - the backtest measured this strategy as losing money.

risk._drawdown_note: Down 25% from the day's STARTING equity -> halt all trading and flag the strategy for reevaluation. Halting is automatic; changing the strategy is not.
risk._minBalance_note: Hard floor read from the EXCHANGE, not local books. At or below this, the kill switch fires regardless of what the bot thinks it has lost.

signal._comment: minEdge is net of fees, re-checked at the real order size. Note this does NOT silence the bot in paper: the model still produces 6-10c disagreements with the market, and the backtest says those disagreements LOSE money. Paper mode trades them on purpose, to build a live forecast record. Watch Brier skill, not P&L.

api._comment: env is derived from mode: 'api' = Kalshi DEMO (fake money), 'api-live' = PRODUCTION (real money). Never store the private key here - only a path to it, outside this repo.
api._postOnly_note: true = rest a maker order and collect the spread (the strategy the research supports). false = cross the spread as a taker.
api._key_note: PRODUCTION key (real money). All funds on exchange 2 (Crypto).
